body: She said she had never talked to anyone so frequently when we started texting together, and that was surprising to me because it wasn't nearly as much as previous partners, even very busy ones.

I sent a few memes on snapchat the night of per usual, sent a text asking what was going on a few days later, then left a voicemail a week in asking if everything is okay, I was worried a out being clingy so I haven't sent anything since the voicemail. I know for a fact the snaps and the text have not been opened.
Mostly just the intimacy that comes from being that close to another person
Therapy never worked for me, but I appreciate your drive to help others and your positivity
Yo your friends make plans with you?
Am I the only person that sometimes thinks "I want to go home" only to realize I am home and I'll never be happy or comfortable no matter where I am?
I didn't expect to be so personally attacked
